newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas has La Grulla natgas find.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas has La Grulla natgas find.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Monday its drilling program in Starr County, Texas, has resulted in the discovery of a new natural gas field.

The discovery well, the Vera 1 was drilled on a 3-D seismic anomaly to a depth of 8,500 feet and encountered 45 feet of Yegua formation natural gas pay in multiple zones between 6,370 and 6,970 feet depth, based upon electric logs made this past weekend, spokesman Simon Ward said.
The well is currently being completed in preparation for flow testing, which is scheduled for early April.
TransTexas noted it completed construction of a 20-inch diameter transmission pipeline from its La Grulla area in 1996 that will be used for natural gas transport from the new field.
It said a delineation drilling program is planned to begin in the area in April.
